protocol_amendment.reason: The exact-commit V12 red-team review found that a complete final destination could remain after an unsuccessful return if post-publication directory fsync failed or hard-link publication succeeded before temporary-name cleanup failed. It also found that committed tests injected ENOTSUP but did not preserve reviewable evidence for the stronger claim that both publication primitives failed on the actual exFAT volume, and that exceptional state restoration and inherited ContextVar aliases needed explicit coverage.
changes: Accept only the V13 document schema and reject V1-V12 without row verification.

Retain fresh ContextVar state per public path call, bind each state to its creating thread, mark it closed before restoring the prior context, reject cross-thread or closed-state semantic use, and reject direct re-entry into an already active path worker.

Replace single-path output acceptance with a two-object publication protocol: the data path alone is never accepted evidence, while a canonical adjacent completion receipt binds the exact destination name, payload byte count, payload SHA-256, experiment, protocol, and its own canonical digest.

Publish both data and receipt through descriptor-walked, no-follow, no-overwrite paths. A failure before the complete receipt appears may leave a permanent orphan or invalid receipt, both classified as unaccepted and non-reusable.

Once a complete receipt reaches its content commit point, later temporary cleanup, file or directory fsync, stat, or close failures are returned as structured warnings and may not turn the call into a contradictory failure return. Receipt validation remains content-bound; a visible canonical receipt whose payload binding matches is accepted, and every absent, orphaned, malformed, or mismatched state is unaccepted.

Add controls for public-worker exceptions, direct callback re-entry, copied-context cross-thread use, copied-context use after closure, post-publication directory-fsync failure, hard-link-success temporary-cleanup failure, interrupted direct payload publication, interrupted direct receipt publication, race-created destinations, receipt mismatch, parent symlinks, and no-overwrite retries.
Describe ENOTSUP coverage only as a forced unsupported-filesystem control. V13 makes no unpreserved claim about which primitive an actual exFAT volume returned.
Clarify that no generated V13 curve-family density row, canonical matrix, runner, launch plan, or run exists; historical V1 development artifacts remain historical and are not relabeled.

Retain the exact completed provenance and predicate vector 480 prime candidates, 112 draws, 336 curve hashes, 218 registered-curve point enumerations, and 4218 predicate hashes for a completed canonical matrix.
Keep every generated curve-family density-row and canonical run budget at zero.
unchanged_mathematical_boundary: The curve grid, predicates, four null replicates, representative compiler, ordering digest, graph object, cap schedule, five-field objective, matched-null thresholds, positive gate, and negative classification remain unchanged.
Exactness remains finite, TOY-EVIDENCE, and MODEL-BOUND to the fixed compiler and order-ideal construction.
The standalone complete five-field semantic oracle remains frozen-B4 only; transient B6 and B8 legacy controls reproduce predecessor values but are not independent five-field oracles.
No relation generation, rank, linear algebra, target descent, fixed-curve preprocessing crossover, rho comparison, exponent, deployment, or ECDLP result is in scope.
residual_external_resource_boundary: Context-local state prevents ordinary synchronous concurrent, nested, re-entrant path-worker, cross-thread copied-context, and stale-context receipt corruption. It is not a hostile same-process Python sandbox or executed-code attestation; same-thread internal monkeypatching and introspection remain out of scope.

A complete matching receipt is a logical content commit, not proof that every fsync succeeded. Structured publication warnings must be preserved by any future runner, and an immutable external artifact store remains a runner obligation.
The forced ENOTSUP controls establish fallback state transitions, not real-filesystem compatibility or durability.
The one-buffer snapshot and lexical preflight are not CPU, wall-time, peak-RSS, parser-object, allocator-retention, disk, I/O, cache-traffic, or memory-bandwidth guarantees.
Canonical B6 and B8 feasibility, serialized output size, cache occupancy, and role resource use remain unmeasured.

The module-load verifier digest is diagnostic only; a future runner must bind the exact commit, command, environment, immutable paths, hard process limits, publication result, and external resource receipts.
protocol_amendment.required_next_review: Validate and commit one exact V13 snapshot, then obtain fresh independent theory, accounting, and red-team review. Three scoped GO decisions could authorize only a separate hash-complete launch-plan design with hard external resource containment, not execution.
